feature: CREATE SERVER TYPE/VERSION/OPTIONS clause parsing and persistence
Per-column optional type specification in CREATE TABLE OF syntax (col WITH OPTIONS form)
Database-level ACL (datacl) on pg_database isn't implemented (heap backing and pg_dump --create-only support pending).
Runtime enforcement of domain CHECK constraints during casting operations
ALTER OPERATOR FAMILY ... ADD to append members to an operator family
Comments cannot be set on built-in collations (OID 0); only user-defined collations support COMMENT ON COLLATION.

Timestamp-timestamp interval arithmetic (subtracting timestamps produces intervals)
Optimize WAL logical change record storage to reduce write-ahead log volume growth during database initialization.
Implement signal-based configuration refresh (SIGHUP-style) for the reload command so configuration changes take effect without restarting the server.
Implement tablespace support for directing table and index storage to different physical locations.
